text:
raj: Quick check — we're onboarding a new Dedicated tenant in norwayeast and running into GPU/ENI limits. Need ND40rs_v2 capacity there (initially 8 GPUs) and a network quota bump (NICs/ENIs + accelerated networking). Can someone confirm current subscription quotas and whether we can request a capacity reservation?

jess: I pulled the current usage for subscription `redwood-prod-ops` — ND40rs_v2 is currently 0/4 quota (so we only have 4 max), and NCv3 family shows 2/10. ENI (network interfaces) are at 184/200.

sam: ugh, 4 GPUs won't cut it. We need 8 reserved for the first week of the rollout. Is there a quick path to request temporary increase + reservation from MS?

jess: We have two paths: 1) open a support request for quota increase and ask for a capacity reservation (capacity reservations are limited by region and SKU availability) or 2) request a capacity reservation via partner channel if we have an Azure partner rep. Reservation lead time varies.

raj: Do we have a partner rep? If not, I'll open the SR. What's the payload for the support ticket?

matt: I can route through our partner contact but will need the subscription ID, tenant ID, and a list of SKUs/quantities + preferred start/end dates. Also want to include fallback regions (westeurope) and tolerance windows.

jess: Ticket payload example:```
Subject: Capacity reservation & quota increase for ND40rs_v2 in norwayeast
Subscription: <REDACTED_SUB_ID>
Tenant: <REDACTED_TENANT_ID>
Requested SKUs: ND40rs_v2 x8 (start 2026-04-05, end 2026-05-05)
Networking: Increase network interfaces (ENI) from 200 -> 500, enable accelerated networking on target VMs
Fallback regions: westeurope (ND40rs_v2), southeastasia (if needed)
Business case: Dedicated inference fleet for new EU customer, SLA requires pinned capacity
Estimated monthly commit: $XXk
```

sam: Perfect. Can we also ask them to unlock `AcceleratedNetworking` per NIC and check any NSG/service tag limits that might block provisioning? We hit weird firewall limits last time.

jess: Add this block to SR: `Please validate subscription level limits for NICs per VM, accelerated networking eligibility, and any service tags or NSG rule limits that could prevent provisioning at scale.`

raj: I'll open the SR now. Any preference for support plan level? Standard vs Professional Direct?

matt: Use Professional Direct for faster capacity escalation — we want Partner+PD if possible. I'll follow up with the partner rep once SR is created.

raj: Created SR: SR-2026-987654321. Link: https://portal.azure.com/#blade/Microsoft_Azure_Support/HelpAndSupportBlade/1/srid/SR-2026-987654321 (added our payload). Tagging infra-bot to track updates.

infra-bot: [ticket created] SR-2026-987654321 created by raj. Status: New. Priority: Sev C (customer request).

jess: Good. I also ran `az vm list-usage --location norwayeast -o table` and attached the output to the SR. Quick note: there is only a small spare pool of ND40rs_v2 in norwayeast — MS said availability might be 3-5 weeks for reservation confirmation unless partner can escalate.

sam: 3-5 weeks is long. We should prepare a fallback plan: 1) run first canary in westeurope, 2) enable cross-region routing in our smart routing policy, 3) enable quantized model variant to reduce GPU count per shard.

jess: Agreed. Also cost note — reserving ND40rs_v2 at scale will add ~25-30% to our monthly committed GPU cost vs on-demand, but gives predictable throughput and prevents preemption. I'll add estimated numbers to the SR attachment.

matt: Action items:
- raj: follow up on SR with PD escalation and post the case owner here (due EOD)
- jess: attach az CLI output + quota screenshots + cost estimate to SR (done)
- sam: prepare fallback deployment plan for westeurope + config changes for smart routing (start tomorrow)
- matt: reach out to partner rep once SR is assigned and request priority handling

raj: noted. If MS pushes back on the ENI increase, we may need to split the tenant into two smaller VM pools behind the same service layer — avoid that if possible but it's a fallback.

infra-bot: [update] SR-2026-987654321 status changed to "In Progress". Assigned to Microsoft support engineer: MS-Eng-5421.

jess: Microsoft asked for the following extra info: 1) peak concurrent VM count, 2) exact VM size + image + accelerated networking setting, 3) subscription contact email. I posted those in the SR thread.

sam: timeline ask: can MS provide an ETA for confirmation by next Tuesday? We need to gate the canary rollout.

matt: I'll ping the partner and ask them to escalate for an answer by Tue COB. If we don't have confirmation, we proceed with westeurope canary.

raj: Thanks everyone. I'll post any updates from MS here and mark the rollout freeze if we don't get confirmed capacity by Tue 09:00 UTC.

jess: One more internal note — open a small Azure Purchase Order for temporary burst capacity in westeurope so we can pay-on-demand if we need extra GPUs for the initial 2 weeks. Saves us from immediate reservation costs.

sam: Agreed. I'll coordinate with finance on a PO and share the spend cap thresholds.

matt: Partner reached out, says they can try to negotiate 2-week priority, but no guarantees. Keep the fallback plan live.

raj: Closing loop for now. Will update thread with SR owner and expected confirmation. :thumbsup:
